title: General
noDatabase: The database is not connected: settings show default values and are not saved. Set the database address in the THREADLINE_DATABASE_URL variable.
databaseDown: The database is unavailable: the last read values are shown, editing is closed. Saving reopens by itself when the database responds.
invalidStored: The stored record of this setting did not pass validation: the default value applies. Saving replaces the record.

lifetimeDays.label: Short link lifetime
lifetimeDays.hint: A whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}. Shortening applies to existing links at once, lengthening only to new ones.
lifetimeDays.shorten: The lifetime goes down from {{from}} to {{to}}: links older than {{to}} days stop opening and are deleted at the next cleanup.
lifetimeDays.invalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

contactText.label: Support contact
contactText.hint: One line, up to {{max}} characters. Shown on the “No access” screen and to Business on the undescribed error line. Empty means no contact is shown.
contactText.invalid: One line, no more than {{max}} characters.

contactUrl.label: Contact link
contactUrl.hint: Optional. https only, without a login and password, up to {{max}} characters.
contactUrl.invalid: An https link without a login and password is needed, no more than {{max}} characters.

problems.conflict: The setting was changed while you were editing it.
problems.unavailable: The database is unavailable, try again later.

leave: There is an unsaved value. Leave the page?
lead: Apply to all projects as soon as they are saved.
